title: Predictive Machine Learning Models and Survival Analysis for COVID-19 Prognosis Based on Hematochemical Parameters.
summary: In a 303-patient COVID-19 cohort, hematochemical predictors and machine-learning survival/prognosis models differentiated mortality and ICU-admission risk; decision tree mortality ROC-AUC was 89.66% and SVM ICU ROC-AUC 95.07%.
ai_technology: KNN imputation, scaling, feature extraction/selection and ML classifiers were applied to clinical and hematochemical variables; Methods §4.
organization: Department of Electrical and Information Engineering (DEI), Polytechnic University of Bari, 70126 Bari, Italy

evidence.tested: In a 303-patient COVID-19 cohort, hematochemical predictors and machine-learning survival/prognosis models differentiated mortality and ICU-admission risk; decision tree mortality ROC-AUC was 89.66% and SVM ICU ROC-AUC 95.07%.
evidence.unknown: Results are limited to the reported models, cohorts, datasets or experiments; broader generalization and clinical or operational benefit were not established.
